verdict.rationale: Zep's own docs call Graphiti, the temporal knowledge-graph framework Zep is built around, "open-source", and its code is on GitHub at getzep/graphiti; a community member thanks Zep for open-sourcing it. The managed Zep service itself (zep-cloud SDK, Cloud or VPC deployment) has no evidence of public source, and no license is named. Missing for 10: evidence that the core Zep platform source is public, the specific open license terms, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license

citations.quote: Graphiti is the open-source temporal knowledge graph framework.
Graphiti is a framework for building and querying temporal context graphs for AI agents.
Thank you for open sourcing this! You are definitely onto something here.
